changes: Added regression coverage proving milestone closeout snapshots survive real DONE worktree merge cleanup, and documented canonical-root readability after cleanup.
usage: Run lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story> after DONE; for regression proof run node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs.
expectedOutcome: After DONE, lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story> prints the final milestone table instead of Snapshot: missing.
actualTranscript: Live smoke ran node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs and exited 0 with stdout: ok milestone-status.
outcomeDiff: No difference: the regression proved canonical-root closeout readability after worktree cleanup.
limitations: No product code path change was needed; this story adds durable regression proof and documentation for the existing DONE persistence behavior.
pitfalls: Scope contract needed explicit acknowledgement for ProofStory lifecycle artifacts, and TEST required both JSON transcript evidence plus a human-readable transcript-diff.md for delivery review.
